frases.texto: You thawed too much chicken, and now you're wondering if you can freeze it again.
frases.estilo: Dry, direct, with a half smile.

frases.texto: You can. It depends on how you thawed it.
Thawed in the fridge? The USDA says it's safe to refreeze it raw.
Thawed in cold water or the microwave? Cook it first, then freeze it.
And if it sat out more than two hours, don't refreeze it. Toss it.
Heads up: refrozen meat can come out a little drier, because it loses moisture as it thaws.
Extra thawed meat: do you refreeze it or cook it?
Save this, then send it to the friend who thaws the whole bag every time.
